verdict.rationale: Scheduling a send and undoing a send are fair questions for an email client, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only generic sending: the Graph API can send, draft, update and delete messages, and can choose whether to save to Sent Items. Nothing in the pack documents delayed or scheduled delivery, or an undo-send grace window.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window
